source_book: Sri Chaitanya — FAST TRACK IPE for Jr. Students, Mathematics-IB (2026-27 edition)
note: Question index for diffing and authoring. Stems restated in our own wording; the mathematics is exact. No solution content from the source book appears in this file, by policy.

questions.stem: When the origin is shifted to (−1, 2) by the translation of axes, find the transformed equation of x² + y² + 2x − 4y + 1 = 0.
When the origin is shifted to the point (2, 3), the transformed equation of a curve is x² + 3xy − 2y² + 17x − 7y − 11 = 0. Find the original equation of the curve.
questions.notes: Printed as ***2(i). There is NO matching 2(ii) anywhere in this chapter — pages 138 and 139 were read end to end and the chapter closes with the *** rule after question 6. The orphan (i) label is recorded as printed; no second part has been invented.

questions.stem: When the axes are rotated through an angle π/4, find the transformed equation of 3x² + 10xy + 3y² = 9.
When the axes are rotated through an angle α, find the transformed equation of x cos α + y sin α = p.
When the axes are rotated through an angle 45°, the transformed equation of a curve is 17x² − 16xy + 17y² = 225. Find the original equation of the curve.
questions.notes: Star prefix sits in the clipped spine gutter; two star glyphs readable and a third may be lost, so 2 is recorded as the readable value.

questions.stem: Show that the axes are to be rotated through an angle ½ Tan⁻¹(2h/(a − b)) so as to remove the xy term from the equation ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0, if a ≠ b, and through the angle π/4 if a = b.
